# Vendored third-party libraries

These files are committed verbatim so the app runs without a package manager. Refresh by re-downloading from the source listed below.

## chart.umd.min.js

- **Library:** Chart.js
- **Version:** 4.4.7
- **License:** MIT (compatible with the app's MIT license)
- **Source:** https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/releases/tag/v4.4.7
- **CDN used to fetch:** `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.7/dist/chart.umd.min.js`
- **Global exposed:** `Chart`

To update: replace this file with the corresponding UMD build from the next 4.x release and bump the version line above.
